prompt:

Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-04-30):
| Current ratio           | 1.18 |
| Retained earnings       | 280,791M |
| Current liabilities     | 216,756M |
| Current assets          | 255,155M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 441,914M |
| Total liabilities       | 474,716M |
| Total assets            | 916,630M |
| EBIT / operating income | 23,852M |
| Revenue                 | 181,519M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
- The company shows solid profitability (EBIT ~13% of revenue) and a conservative leverage profile (Total liabilities ~52% of assets; debt/equity around 1.07) with adequate liquidity (current ratio 1.18). Absence of interest coverage data prevents a precise assessment, but on given metrics, credit risk appears moderate and consistent with an investment-grade rating.
DECISION: A
